## UseViewportOptions.viewportStore property

Delegates the viewport to an external store. Named for its domain, not just `store`<!-- -->, so it reads the same on a component that also has a `selectionStore` — see the naming rule in the `bio-viz-conventions` project skill.

**Signature:**

```typescript
viewportStore?: StoreController<Viewport>;
```
